builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Galio: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (2,762 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.1% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: An anti-magic engage and counter-engage fighter who chains control and empowered area attacks. His allied-target ultimate rewards reacting to an existing fight rather than initiating anywhere freely. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Hextech Rocketbelt → Imperial Mandate → Zhonya's Hourglass. Stormraider's Surge keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Mercury's Treads, Thornmail, Rabadon's Deathcap.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Hextech Rocketbelt → Imperial Mandate → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Stormraider's Surge.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Hextech Rocketbelt → Imperial Mandate → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.1% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Hextech Rocketbelt → Imperial Mandate → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for [5] seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone.

When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for [0.75] seconds and deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.7) × AP + (1) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] magic damage.

Passive: Galio gains a [(0.075 / 0.09 / 0.105 / 0.12 / 0.135) × Stat(12)] Magic Shield after not taking damage for [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=12, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by [(0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0004) × AP + (0.0008) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (1)] and incoming physical damage by [((0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 + (0.0004) × AP + (0.0008) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (1)) × (0.5)] and Slows himself by [15]%.

Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between [0.5] to [1.5] seconds, deals between [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.3) × AP] and [(20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.3) × AP) × (3)] magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for [2] seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.

Galio's Attacks have increased attack speed and deal [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 115; raw flags preserved) + (1) × AD + (0.4) × AP + (0.6) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] magic damage to surrounding enemies. 

This effect's cooldown is reduced by [3] seconds when Galio hits an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability, once per cast.

Galio fires two windblasts that deal [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage each. When the windblasts meet, they combine into a tornado that deals [(2 + (0.01) × AP) × (4)]% max Health magic damage over [2] seconds.

Galio lunges forward with a mighty blow, Knocking Up for [0.75] seconds and dealing [100 / 135 / 170 / 205 / 240 + (1) × AP] magic damage to the first champion hit. Other enemies in the way take [(100 / 135 / 170 / 205 / 240 + (1) × AP) × (0.8)] magic damage.

Galio's dash stops on hitting terrain.

builds.name: Resistance smash carry
builds.summary: Test resistance smash carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test resistance smash carry against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Colossal Smash includes a 0.6 source-MR term and Hero's Entrance includes 1.0 source MR; defensive MR can therefore contribute magic damage while W shields and mitigates. Dusk and Dawn supplies a separate magic Spellblade attack between spell hits that refund passive cooldown.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy magic damage and repeated ability hits on champions.
Compare Smash and R damage with matched AP but different MR.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Physical compositions waste the MR focus; Smash still requires melee access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: MR source statFormula=2 is not automatically verified bonus MR; R needs an allied landing target.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Abyssal Mask, Kaenic Rookern, Frozen Heart, Spirit Visage, Dusk and Dawn, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Engage and rescue
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Galio: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: An anti-magic engage and counter-engage fighter who chains control and empowered area attacks. His allied-target ultimate rewards reacting to an existing fight rather than initiating anywhere freely. Can AP and empowered attacks repay lost anti-magic/frontline durability? Record taunt contact, passive cooldown and whether the allied-target R can actually join the fight. A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
builds.summary: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
testPlan: Kit question for Galio: Can AP and empowered attacks repay lost anti-magic/frontline durability? Record taunt contact, passive cooldown and whether the allied-target R can actually join the fight.

Start with the early core (Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

The route fails Galio's stated kit question: Can AP and empowered attacks repay lost anti-magic/frontline durability? Record taunt contact, passive cooldown and whether the allied-target R can actually join the fight.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.
Full cost 10,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Knight's Vow, Zeke's Convergence, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Smash attack tempo
builds.summary: Test smash attack tempo against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test smash attack tempo against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Colossal Smash's 0.4 AP and total-AD terms reward attacks after spells, while Q/E hits cut its cooldown by three seconds once per cast. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn create independent magic attack packets; Terminus fits physical ordinary attacks plus magic spells.
testPlan: Required state: Alternate distinct spell casts with attacks rather than spam one tornado.
Count Smash activations and attack packets in a ten-second duel.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack purchases reduce burst and cannot bypass passive cooldown.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q tornado ticks cannot be treated as unlimited passive refunds.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
